messages:
Ethan (Partnerships): Quick sync — I'd like to pilot a lightweight 'Integrator Badge + Bounty' program with 3 hardware/cloud partners next month. Objective: speed up SI readiness, give measurable hands-on signals, and surface verified integrators in the marketplace. Ideas?

Lea (SI Enablement): Love the idea. Suggest 3 tiers: observer, implementer, verified. Each tier = short hands-on lab (~45m), a 5-question quiz, + one customer demo recording for the verified tier.

Sam (Solutions): +1. We should require a tiny reference app + a terraform snippet so partners can spin up Redwood Private quickly. Example snippet for the demo environment:
```
# terraform snippet for integrator demo
module "redwood_demo" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/integrator-demo.git//aws"
  version = "v0.1.0"
  instance_type = "t3.large"
}
```

Anita (Field): Sales will want clear incentives. Propose $2k referral bounty for the first customer contract closed with a "verified" integrator. Also offer marketplace priority listing as a non-cash incentive. @Jorge can you confirm budget? :moneybag:

Jorge (GTM): I'll check with finance. Pinged them just now. Marketplace priority listing sounds great and cheaper than cash. Need to draft terms for how we measure "first customer contract" attribution.

onboard-bot: New curriculum created — "Badge-Bounty v0.1". Resources: /kb/si/badge-bounty-v0.1 and auto-assessment endpoint at /api/si-badge/v0/check.

Maya (PartnerEng): I can own the sandbox exercises. Can we automate acceptance criteria? Idea: a smoke test that validates /health returns 200 and an eval harness that runs two prompts and checks response similarity > 0.7. Keeps manual review minimal.

Lea (SI Enablement): Draft checklist below. Assign owners and we'll aim for a 2-week pilot prep. :spiral_calendar:
```
- Curriculum draft (Lea) [ ]
- Lab infra & exercises (Maya) [ ]
- Marketplace listing template (Jorge) [ ]
- Referral/legal terms (Anita + Legal) [ ]
- Badge issuance & automation scripts (Sam) [ ]
- Pilot invite list (Partner Success) [ ]
```

Ethan (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Tue 10am PT. Please add blockers here. Also let's track in JIRA -> SI-BADGE-101.

Lea (SI Enablement): :thumbsup: I'll add acceptance criteria doc to /docs/si/badges and link the quiz questions.

Anita (Field): Heads up — we need a compliance checkbox for on-prem/private deployments (KMS/HSM requirement). Will coordinate with Security.

Sam (Solutions): For the demo app keep resources minimal — no required GPU. I'll share regen instructions and a test dataset.

Jorge (GTM): Finance approved a provisional bounty pool for Q2 pending exec signoff. That should let us pilot without blocking.

Ethan (Partnerships): Great — if no major blockers, we'll go ahead with the pilot invite list by EOW. Thanks all. :rocket:
